source.title: Dedicatory Burial/Offering Complexes at the Moon Pyramid, Teotihuacan: A preliminary report of 1998–2004 explorations
source.inspection: selected pp.127–143, figs 1,5,8,11,13 inspected; not full text beyond p.143
source.rights: 2007 Cambridge University Press; Moon Pyramid Project figures NOT cleared for reuse

findings.assertion: Burial 6 stone-walled chamber 5.0 x 4.5 m, 2 m high; 9.6 m north of composite Building 5 center and 4.6 m south of main-platform center; tentative Building 5 assignment about AD 300
Burial 6 contained 12 individuals, 6A–B complete centrally and 6C–L lacking skulls and first cervical vertebrae in northern area; bound arms suggested by their position
findings.limit: identities and manner of death are not proven

findings.assertion: Burial 6 central 18 obsidian eccentrics formed nine pairs of undulating knives and feathered serpents; above were pyrite disk and anthropomorphic figurines; provisional faunal counts at least 2 canines, 4 felines, 14 birds
findings.limit: preliminary faunal counts, ritual meaning is interpretation

findings.assertion: Burial 5 individual 5C wore composite shell-greenstone ear ornaments and shell disk necklace; decayed wooden object beside right arm, hands covering puma mandible
